Company Overview:

Globally Leading Embodied AI Education Technology R&D Platform
Beijing AIBingo Technology Co., Ltd. (AIBingo), founded in 2015, is China's first high-tech company to apply artificial intelligence robots to educational services. Its core team originates from Tsinghua University's Intelligent Robot Center, led by Dr. Min Haibo. The company has established a globally leading R&D platform for embodied AI education technology, pioneering multimodal environmental perception and cognition technologies to provide intelligent interactive solutions for children's education scenarios.

Comprehensive Full-Scene AI Education Solutions
AIBingo has built a product matrix covering the entire educational spectrum, including AI Teaching Assistant Robots, Bingo Smart Light Tutoring Robots, an AI curriculum system for ages 3-15, AI Innovation Laboratory solutions, and a Smart Campus IoT Management Platform. By integrating visual, auditory, and tactile multimodal technologies, it enables personalized education and intelligent management.

Significant Market Presence and User Base
AIBingo has served over 16,000 schools across China, reaching more than 6 million young people. It has established over a hundred AI education experimental zones and thousands of experimental schools, achieving the top position in both the implementation and deployment quantity of AI robot courses, solidifying its undisputed industry benchmark status. As the technical support unit for competitions on the Chinese Ministry of Education's White List, it has successfully co-organized international events such as the IRO International Robot Olympiad China Finals, ICC Inventions Creativity Competition China Finals, and World Robot Contest (WRC). It also collaborates in industry-university-research initiatives with Tsinghua University, Xi'an Jiaotong University, Xinhua Bookstore, Huawei's Seres Auto, and others to promote practical, research-based learning.

Numerous Industry Honors and Brand Influence
The company's new product for home users, the Smart Light Tutoring Robot, as the first screen-free AI tutoring device, won the "Gold Medal at the Geneva International Exhibition of Inventions." AIBingo was selected for EY's 2025 "Enterprise with the Most Potential" program and has received honors including National High-Tech Enterprise recognition, Zhongguancun High-Tech Enterprise status, Beijing Municipal Specialized, Refined, Unique, and New (SRUN) Enterprise certification, the MIIT "AI Industry Innovation Scenario Application Case" certification, and the GMIC Global Innovation Gold Award. Founder Dr. Min Haibo has been interviewed multiple times by CCTV and featured by authoritative media like Xinhua Net, CNR Net, and China Education Daily. He has deservedly received numerous awards, such as Cailian Press's "2024 New Radical Business Leader," the "Economic Figure - Technological Innovation Award" at the 2024 Annual Economic Conference, the "2023 China Education Craftsman Spirit Figure" award, and Tencent's "Echo China" Industry Leader award in both 2022 and 2021, establishing a highly influential industry exemplar.

Forward-Looking Capital Structure and Future Plans
The company has completed 9 rounds of funding from investors including guidance funds from the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS), the Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission, the SASAC (State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission), as well as well-known VCs and state-owned industrial funds. With its core strategy of "AI + Industrial Internet," AIBingo is gradually building a big data platform for youth development, steadily advancing its IPO process, and striving to make AI technology truly accessible to hundreds of millions of families.

Company Overview:

A Leader in Automotive Intelligent Electronics for 14 Years
With 14 years of specialization in automotive intelligent electronics, our company is a national high-tech enterprise integrating R&D, mass production, sales, and full-cycle technical services. We are headquartered in Beijing and operate an R&D and operations center in Shenzhen, providing safe, intelligent automotive electronic systems and full-stack customized solutions for passenger vehicles, commercial and special vehicles, unmanned logistics, and two-wheeler smart mobility.

Innovation Driven by Independent R&D
Guided by the mission of "Technology Drives Mobility Safety & Intelligent Upgrade," we focus on deep R&D in foundational automotive electronics. Holding a complete independent intellectual property systemincluding 31 software copyrights and 9 national invention patentsour core technologies span image processing, ADAS, telematics, and embedded development. All our products meet strict automotive-grade certifications and support flexible customization across diverse vehicle models and application scenarios.

Comprehensive Product Portfolio for Full-Scenario Mobility
We offer three core product lines designed to address intelligent upgrade needs across varied mobility scenarios:

Our flagship 360 Surround View Monitor (AVM) System has been refined over 14 years and is compatible with nearly all domestic passenger vehicles, with proven mass-production experience in commercial and special vehicle segments. The portfolio includes 2D/3D panoramic view, parking assistance, and integrated ADAS functions, supported by full-chain services from algorithm licensing to mass production, with industry-leading cumulative shipments.
We also provide an Unmanned Logistics Vehicle Intelligent Control System, leveraging our intelligent driving expertise to deliver tailored solutions for low-speed unmanned logistics. This system covers environment perception, path planning, automated parking, and remote monitoring, and is adaptable to campus logistics, urban last-mile delivery, and similar scenarios.
In addition, our Motorcycle Smart Infotainment System offers full-stack two-wheeler intelligent cockpit solutions based on automotive-grade R&D capabilities. It includes high-definition digital clusters, GPS navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, and two-wheeler ADAS, and can be fully customized to enhance intelligent and safe riding.


Trusted Partnership and Industry Recognition
Backed by 14 years of industry experience, robust R&D capabilities, and a complete mass-production delivery system, we serve leading domestic automotive OEMs, commercial and special vehicle manufacturers, tier-1 suppliers, motorcycle brands, and unmanned logistics enterprises, establishing ourselves as a reliable partner in China's automotive intelligent electronics sector.

Looking Ahead: Shaping Smarter, Safer Mobility
Moving forward, we will continue to deepen core automotive electronics R&D, expand into new intelligent mobility scenarios, and collaborate with partners worldwide. Our commitment remains to advance the safety and intelligence of the mobility industry through premium products and tailored solutions.

Company Overview:

A Leader in Power Solutions Since 2010
Established in 2010, Boluo Xurong Electronics is a recognized national high-tech enterprise with over 15 years of dedicated expertise in the power supply industry. We integrate innovative R&D, intelligent manufacturing, and global sales operations to provide high-performance, reliable power solutions for a worldwide clientele. Our modern 8,000-square-meter factory in Huizhou, Guangdong Province, boasts an annual production capacity of over 2 million units, forming a robust foundation for meeting large-scale international demands.

Comprehensive Product Portfolio for Diverse Applications
Our extensive product range is engineered to meet the needs of various sectors. We specialize in computer power supplies (including PC, SFX, and FLEX series) and robust industrial power systems (such as redundant, server, and fully customized non-standard power supplies). The power output of our products spans a wide spectrum from 200W to 10,000W, effectively catering to diverse application scenarios in consumer electronics, data centers, and industrial automation.

Core Technological Innovations and Customization
At the heart of our products lies a commitment to technological advancement. Our proprietary innovations include independently developed intelligent temperature control technology, achieving Titanium-level conversion efficiency of 96%+, and patented circuit designs. We employ a modular architecture that facilitates rapid customization, allowing us to adapt quickly to specific client requirements. All our power supplies are equipped with comprehensive protection features, including OVP (Over Voltage Protection), SCP (Short Circuit Protection), UVP (Under Voltage Protection), and OPP (Over Power Protection).

Uncompromising Quality and Global Compliance
We implement a rigorous, four-dimensional quality control system that exceeds industry standards. This process encompasses material-level inspection using Japanese industrial-grade components, stringent in-line process control with AOI and ICT testing, extreme environmental testing, and thorough reliability verification in our own EMC lab. Our quality management is certified to ISO 9001:2015, and our products carry major global certifications, including CE, FCC, CB, CCC, TUV, and 80PLUS Bronze to Platinum energy efficiency ratings, ensuring seamless market access worldwide.

Proven Global Partnership and Service
Xurong Electronics has established a strong international presence, exporting to 56 countries and regions. We are committed to superior service, offering 24-hour rapid response support, which has contributed to a customer satisfaction rate consistently above 98% for five consecutive years. We sincerely invite global distributors and partners to visit our facility to explore opportunities for collaboration and jointly pioneer the next era of power supply technology.

As the world's first manufacturer to mass-produce 210W GaN chargers, the company leverages its independently developed ADC2.0 fast-charging algorithm to ensure compatibility with 98% of mainstream devices, setting industry benchmarks for power efficiency and innovation.

Quality and reliability are central to CUKTECH's product philosophy. All products undergo stringent testing, including 1,200-cycle lifespan assessments, and are certified to IEC 62133 and UN 38.3 safety standards. An AI-powered intelligent temperature-control system further enhances durability and user safety, reflecting a commitment to military-grade robustness across its portfolio of intelligent power banks (15,000-20,000mAh) and high-speed data cables supporting USB4/PD3.1 protocols.

Comprehensive Product Ecosystem for Diverse Needs
CUKTECH offers a fully integrated charging matrix designed for desktop, portable, and in-car scenarios. Its distinctive Electric Energy Column series enables simultaneous multi-device fast charging, while products like the 65W Energy Card exemplify ultra-compact design, achieving a 41% reduction in size compared to conventional models. This blend of functionality and aesthetics has been recognized with multiple international awards, including consecutive German Red Dot Design awards in 2023 and 2024.

Global Compliance and Scalable Manufacturing

The company's supply chain strength is reinforced by strategic partnerships with top-tier suppliers like ATL and TI, complemented by a 32,000 smart factory capable of producing over 800,000 units monthly. Core Technical Capabilities

Professional Dual-System Smart Tracker Manufacturer

No app download needed - just open the built-in tracker on the phone. This is not just a feature - it's the foundation of every product we make.

Smart Tags: Round, card, key holder, and rechargeable tracker styles.

This variety allows buyers to diversify their offerings from a single, reliable source.

R&D Excellence in Dual-System Integration
Our in-house R&D team has years of experience fine-tuning dual-system compatibility. We continuously test and update our products to ensure they work flawlessly with the latest iOS and Android updates. This expertise makes us the ideal partner for OEM/ODM projects requiring reliable dual-system performance.

Commitment to Quality Assurance
Quality is embedded in our process. Every product, from a simple luggage tag to a complex smart tag, undergoes rigorous functionality, battery life, and signal stability tests before shipment. We stand behind our products with reliable after-sales support.

Global Export Experience

Company Overview:

Introduction

Founded in 2005, JACC Office Machine Co., Ltd. (also known as Dongguan Jiaxi Office Machine Co., Ltd.) is a factory-direct OEM and ODM manufacturer of office machines, craft tools, and home appliances based in Dongguan, China. With over 20 years of export experience, we focus on delivering innovative, certified, and reliable products to global buyers. JACC operates as the global-facing brand for marketing, product development, and OEM/ODM cooperation, while Dongguan Jiaxi serves as the registered manufacturing entity responsible for production, certifications, and regulatory compliance. Both entities share the same management team, R&D resources, manufacturing facilities, and quality control systems, ensuring consistent standards across all products.

 

Exporting Worldwide

We manufacture a broad range of office equipment such as laminators, binding machines, shredders, paper trimmers, and thermal printers, as well as craft and DIY tools including foil applicators, embossing machines, discbound punches, scoring boards, and bookbinding systems. Our home appliance portfolio covers food vacuum sealers, storage solutions, and multifunctional sealing products. These products are exported worldwide to Europe, North and South America, Australia, Japan, and the Middle East, serving importers, distributors, retailers, supermarkets, and e-commerce brands.

 

International Certifications

Our ISO9001- and ISO14001-certified facilities support a monthly capacity of approximately 200,000 units. The factory has passed BSCI, Sedex, ISO9001, and ISO14001 audits, and our products comply with CE, GS, ETL, UL, RoHS, and FSC packaging requirements, as well as ErP and environmental regulations. Quality assurance is built into every stage of production through ERP-managed supply chains, 100% inspection, third-party audits by SGS and TUV, and full 6S management.

 

Over 20,000 Square Meters

Strong in-house R&D and engineering capabilities enable continuous product improvement, structural optimization, and technology innovation, supported by multiple utility and design patents. The factory covers more than 20,000 square meters and employs over 600 skilled workers, with dedicated QC and engineering teams and 16 automated production lines covering injection molding, assembly, aging tests, and packaging. We ship millions of units annually with export turnover exceeding USD 20 million.

 

OEM and ODM Services

Company Overview:

Specializing in Precision Metal Stamping Since 2008
Founded in 2008, Dongguan Kaiyan Hardware Products Co., Ltd. is a manufacturing company specializing in precision metal stamping. Our main products include batteries for new energy vehicles, LED power supply housings, aluminum panels, chassis, brackets, shovel-tooth radiators and sheets, electronic RF shields, socket spring contacts, drawn parts, structural components, terminals, home appliance parts, and toys.

Offering a Complete Range of Services
We provide a complete range of services, including product development, mold design and manufacturing, stamping processing, finished product assembly, etching inspection, packaging, customs declaration, and transportation. To meet market demands and the quality standards of both domestic and international customers, our company has invested in a variety of imported testing equipment, such as 2.5D measuring instruments, projectors, salt spray testers, electrodeposition thickness gauges, micro Vickers hardness testers, Rockwell hardness testers, surface roughness meters, height gauges, and micrometers. This allows us to ensure the testing and control capabilities needed for precision hardware processing and manufacturing.

Working with Tesla, Samsung, Huawei, Foster, and Whirlpool
The company's existing cooperative customers include first-class suppliers such as Tesla, Samsung, Huawei, Foster, and Whirlpool. We have customers in many countries, including the United States, Germany, Japan, France, Denmark, and Spain. The company has obtained ISO 9001:2015 management system certification and operates a comprehensive quality control system.

Strict Quality Control
The company has always adhered to the philosophy of "quality first," training and supervising all employees to establish a quality-oriented mindset. We ensure strict quality control throughout the entire process, from raw material input, production, surface treatment, full inspection, packaging, to finished product delivery, thereby reducing or eliminating defective products, significantly improving product quality, and meeting customers' requirements for both quality and delivery time.

Experienced Technicians and Managers
We boast a team of experienced technicians and managers, including a dedicated technical management team for new product development. We can provide customers with a complete set of solutions covering new product proofing, trial production (sampling), assembly, and mass production. Moreover, we are capable of collaborating with customers in new product development, offering effective solutions, reducing their R&D costs, shortening the development cycle, and delivering a qualified product series.

We provide learning opportunities for every in-service employee, formulate targeted learning plans, and continuously enhance their work skills. This ensures a steady supply of more professional, technical talents and strengthens quality assurance for the company's long-term development. With meticulous attention to detail and dedicated enthusiasm, the Keyan team is ready to serve you better.

Company Overview and Strategic Position
Dongguan Laudtec Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd is your strategic partner for premium smart accessories. As the co-creation engine behind leading smart accessory brands worldwide, we partner with global electronics retailers, brand owners, and educational institutions to deliver differentiated products through manufacturing excellence and true collaboration. With 18 years of specialized experience, we transform concepts into market-ready solutions.

Manufacturing Capabilities
We operate a vertically integrated 7,107-square-meter facility in Dongguan, controlling every step from in-house mold design to final assembly. Our manufacturing strength includes 40+ advanced two-color injection molding machines that deliver seamless dual-material integration, achieving razor-sharp color boundaries and flawless finishes while increasing production speed by 30 to 50 percent. We maintain a 100,000-class dust-free workshop ensuring zero contamination for premium transparent cases, and our in-house mold design team creates 90 percent of our molds internally with 0.02mm tolerance for complete IP protection.

Certifications and Compliance
We are BSCI Grade B and ISO 9001 certified, meeting global retailers' compliance standards with guaranteed ethical manufacturing. Our commitment to quality and sustainability ensures that every product leaving our facility meets the highest international standards.

Core Product Portfolio
Our USB-C keyboard cases feature flexible connector technology that solves the snap-off problem common in rigid designs, offering a direct USB-C connect with no Bluetooth pairing, no battery charging, and no signal dropouts. These cases provide audio and video output for direct connection to projectors and smart boards, with a magic keyboard-inspired design, detachable rugged cases, and easy-clean surfaces ideal for shared devices. Available for iPads in multiple sizes and select Android tablets, they can be customized with school logos and asset tags. We also offer mobile cases in volume and premium series, tablet cases and folios with reinforced corners and integrated kickstands, and education and enterprise bundles with bulk packaging and kitting, custom branding, barcodes, serialization, and full compliance dossiers for procurement bids.

Strategic Partnerships and Service Commitment
Our strategic partnerships with major European electronics retailers demonstrate our proven trust, delivering full compliance documentation including CE, RoHS, REACH, modular SKU design, retail-ready packaging, and over 99% on-time delivery. We provide rapid sampling within 7 to 15 days, flexible MOQs from 300 units, retail-ready packaging with GS1 barcodes, and complete supply chain transparency with real-time updates and full traceability. See live demonstrations of our USB-C keyboard cases, premium dual-color mobile cases, rugged tablet folios, and private label samples and packaging.

Company Overview:

17 Years of Industry Expertise
Dongguan Meycun Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional electronics manufacturing service (EMS) provider with 17 years of industry expertise. The company specializes in OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturing) and ODM (Original Design Manufacturing) services, delivering comprehensive solutions from initial product design to final assembly. With a commitment to quality, innovation, and corporate responsibility, Meycun Electronics serves a diverse global clientele, having successfully collaborated with over 300 customers.

Manufacturing Prowess and Technical Expertise
The company operates a robust manufacturing facility equipped with 6 SMT (Surface Mount Technology) lines and 6 automatic THT (Through-Hole Technology) lines, supported by a skilled workforce of approximately 300 technicians. Its core strength lies in a reliable supply chain, including strategic partnerships with key IC suppliers such as Joulwatt and South Chip, who are also suppliers to major brands like Huawei, Xiaomi, and Samsung. Meycun Electronics further demonstrates its technical capability through a dedicated R&D team of 2 electronics engineers and 2 structural engineers. This team manages the entire development process from mold design and PCBA layout to final assembly, delivering approximately 5 new ODM products annually and handling 2-3 new ODM cases per month, backed by an annual investment of around 3 million RMB in mold development.

Stringent Quality Assurance and Compliance
Quality control is integral to Meycun's operations, managed by a dedicated team of 30 QC personnel. The company implements a rigorous, multi-stage inspection protocol covering Incoming (IQC), In-Process (IPQC), and Final Quality Control (EQC). The process involves thorough checks of electronic components and structural parts, real-time monitoring of SMT/THT defects, comprehensive performance and safety testing (including high/low voltage, surge protection, and efficiency), and a final full appearance inspection. All finished products undergo an aging process, powered under rated load for 2-4 hours to identify potential failures. This system is supported by advanced equipment, including AOI machines, protection testers, power analyzers, and automated aging lines. The company's quality standards are validated by third-party certifications from TUV and SGS, alongside adherence to BSCI, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001 standards, reflecting its commitment to social responsibility and environmental management.

Global Engagement and Future Vision
Meycun Electronics actively engages with the global market, regularly participating in major international trade shows such as the HK Global Resources Exhibition. The company maintains a consistent and professional presence, showcasing its capabilities at dedicated booths. Looking forward, Meycun is expanding its footprint with a new 13,000 sqm factory in Shenzhen's Guangming district, scheduled for operation in April 2026. This expansion signifies its growth and enhanced production capacity. The company fosters a responsible corporate culture, emphasizing employee welfare and shared destiny, which translates into high-quality products and reliable service, supported by a remarkably low general defect rate of 0.1-0.3%. For global partners, the company offers flexible trade terms, primarily FOB and EXW.

Company Overview:

Focused on Open-Ear Audio Innovation

Dongguan Naiting Acoustic Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2014, is a professional manufacturer dedicated to open-ear headphones and audio solutions. With 11 years of audio expertise and 6 years specializing in open-ear technology, the company has become a trusted OEM/ODM partner for global brands. Its product lines cover air conduction and bone conduction headphones, including IPX5 air conduction sports headphones, IPX5-IPX7 bone conduction sports headphones, IP68 swimming headphones, bone conduction hearing aids, Bluetooth audio glasses, bone conduction helmet headphones, and call center headsets.

Strong R&D and Engineering Capability

Backed by a team of 17 senior engineers and more than 100 patents, Naiting leads the industry in structural design, acoustic tuning, and applied innovation. From introducing the first air conduction headphones in 2019, to bone conduction hearing aids in 2021, helmet-integrated devices in 2022, and open-ear noise cancellation in 2023, the company continuously proves its ability to tackle high-barrier technical challenges and deliver market-ready solutions.

Certified Quality and Global Compliance

The company operates under ISO9001, ISO14001, and BSCI certifications, with products conforming to CE, RoHS, and FCC standards, and battery safety requirements including MSDS and UN38.3. Equipped with a strict QC/QA system and over a dozen professional testing devices, Naiting ensures that every shipment meets the highest quality standards, while also assisting clients with local product certification worldwide.

Large-Scale Manufacturing Capacity

With two factories located in Shenzhen (2,000 sqm) and Dongguan (6,000 sqm), the company employs 200-250 staff and achieves a production capacity of up to 300,000 units per month. Specific models such as IPX5 sports headphones can reach 10,000 pcs per day, while IP68 swimming headphones can reach 2,000-3,000 pcs per day. Typical lead time for customized OEM/ODM projects is 20-25 days, ensuring both large-scale production capability and on-time delivery.

Trusted by Global Brands

Naiting products are widely recognized in Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea, and China. The company has cooperated with well-known names such as CCTV, ZDEER, Britz, IRIVER, ATWO, PORTRONICS, RCA, Outdoor Tech, JETE, FUKUMIMI, ELSONIC, and many others under NDA. With experience in brand clients procurement processes, the team is adept at risk control, communication efficiency, and long-term partnership building.

Laptop Batteries for Apple MacBook, Dell, ASUS, HP, ACER, Lenovo, and More
Dongguan Xinsineng Electronics Co., Ltd. is located in the world's manufacturing capital - Dongguan, China, a leading global foundry that replaces laptop batteries. With the most complete models of laptop batteries in the industry, Xinsineng products cover a full range of laptop battery applications, such as for Apple MacBook, for Dell, for ASUS, for HP, for ACER, for Lenovo, for Microsoft Surface, for Fujitsu, for Samsung, for NEC, etc.

In the application battery of MacBook, Xinsineng has occupied the leading foundry market share. Xinsineng has a professional R&D team composed of dozens of R&D engineers to provide complete solutions for laptop batteries.

Introduced A Series of Advanced Equipment 
In recent years, Xinsineng has introduced a series of advanced equipment, including laser LOGO customization equipment, fully-intelligent testing equipment, automatic spot welding machines, aging cabinets, sub-capacity cabinets, automatic cell pairing equipment, and turntable hot-pressing welding machines. To ensure product quality and craftsmanship, the company has strict inspection procedures and quality control management, including raw material inspection, unit inspection, online inspection, semi-finished product inspection and finished product inspection. At present, it has formed a research and development design room, a material testing room, a sample testing room, and an aging room to ensure that each battery can meet the quality requirements of users and create sustainable business value for partners.

Eight Production Lines
Xinsineng has 124 employees, a production area of 2,800 square meters, 8 production lines and automated production equipment, achieving a monthly production capacity of more than 60,000 single-model laptop batteries.

Certificates like PSE, UN38.3, MSDS, CE, FCC, RoHS, and IEC 62133

For more than ten years, Xinsineng has provided numerous OEM and ODM solutions to partners around the world.

Company Overview:

What We Do
ZHICOOL designs and manufactures high-reliability replacement batteries for smartphones, with an expanding portfolio for related smart devices. We serve three B2B segments:

Repair networks and service centers that require stable supply, predictable quality, and clear warranty terms.
Wholesalers and distributors that need broad SKU coverage, strong documentation, and repeatable margins.
Building private labels with end-to-end support from brand to delivery for OEM and ODM partners.

Track record: Our core team has more than 10 years of experience in cell selection, pack engineering, and high-throughput manufacturing. The brand was founded in 2020, began overseas expansion in 2023, and now has active channels in the United Kingdom, Turkey, Brazil, Malaysia, and Vietnam.

Flexible Lead Times You Can Plan Around

Four automated production lines with annual capacity exceeding two million units, expandable in peak seasons.
Lead times: samples in 3 to 5 days for mainstream SKUs; mass production typically 7 to 10 days after confirmation, depending on volume and SKU mix.

Outcome: Fewer stock-outs, smoother rollouts, and better cash-flow planning for partners.

Premium Quality That Reduces Rework

Three-stage inspection: IQC, IPQC, and OQC with SPC monitoring.
First-pass yield of 99.6 percent; defect rate less than or equal to 0.4 percent tracked by batch.
Tight internal resistance windows and true-capacity cell selection minimize early-life returns.
Traceability: QR or serial, one pack, one ID. Batch analytics drive continuous improvement and faster RMA decisions.

Outcome: Faster bench work, fewer comeback jobs, better store reviews, and less friction between sales and after-sales.

Clear Shipment Instructions

CE, RoHS, FCC, CCC, UN38.3, and MSDS file sets available.
UN38.3 transport compliance with standardized packing and labeling for air and sea.
Country-specific templates for the European Union, the United Kingdom, and Southeast Asia, plus platform-audit-ready documentation.
Coordination with your forwarders; clear packing lists and bill of lading elements to meet destination norms.

Outcome: Confident shipping, quicker customs clearance, and easier onboarding with chains and marketplaces.

Warranty and RMA You Can Trust

Warranty up to 14 months, configurable by market and channel.
Target defect returns less than or equal to 0.4 percent with a fast-track DOA process.
Eight-discipline and corrective and preventive action methods for any batch-level anomalies; photo and video pre-screening to reduce unnecessary logistics.

Outcome: Predictable resolution times, data-driven answers rather than disputes, and satisfied downstream clients.

OEM and ODM That Launch, Not Linger

A team of more than 20 specialists across market planning, brand and visual identity, packaging engineering, documentation, and quality assurance.
End-to-end support: strategy, design, packaging, certification, and delivery.
Anti-counterfeit features, serialization, multilingual kits, and retail or wholesale dual packaging options.

Outcome: A private label with distinctiveness and shelf discipline, shipped on time so you control the margin story.

Company Overview:

Registered Capital of 20.9424 Million RMB
Founded in December 2020 with a registered capital of 20.9424 million RMB, Foshan Lieber Microelectronics Co., Ltd. is a technology innovation enterprise specializing in the R&D, production, and sales of MOSFETs, motor drive control modules, and new energy inverters.

Introduction to Drive Control Algorithms
With the diversification of downstream application requirements and the increasing complexity of motor control tasks, the demand for motor drive control algorithms has also grown. Consequently, the quality of these algorithms directly determines the motor's control performance, making them the core of both motor technology and intelligent products. Drive control algorithms can be broadly categorized into five types:

Sensored Square Wave Control
Sensorless Square Wave Control
Sensored SVPWM Control
Sensored FOC Control
Sensorless FOC Control

Currently, drive control algorithms are evolving from Square Wave Control towards Sensored SVPWM and FOC technologies, with algorithm complexity continuously increasing.

Product Application Modules
The company's power tool drive modules primarily focus on garden tools, including automatic lawn mowers and electric shears. Other motor drive control modules cater to applications such as drones, surface intelligent robots, automotive water pumps, and blowers. In the household appliance sector, Lieber Micro's main controller products include those for fans, vacuum cleaners, massage guns, and electric bicycles.

Inverter Technology & Applications
The fundamental operating principle of the company's inverter boards is similar to that of garden electric tool control systems. While garden tool controllers manage a DC power supply and convert it into AC three-phase control for motors, inverter boards perform DC-to-AC conversion, transforming the current from new energy storage battery packs or solar photovoltaic sources into AC output, with voltages adjusted to 110V or 220V. Currently, these inverter boards are primarily used in applications such as emergency power supplies and portable outdoor energy storage systems.

Company Overview:

Company Profile
Guangdong Cvasun New Energy Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2015, is a national high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, production, and sales of lithium-ion polymer batteries. Headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong Province, the company operates from a 300,000-square-meter facility with a skilled workforce of approximately 1,400 employees.

Business Scope
Cvasun New Energy focuses on the entire lithium battery industry chain. Our comprehensive operations cover the R&D of battery materials, cells, and systems; the manufacturing of lithium-ion polymer cells; battery recycling and reuse; and product import/export services.

Core Products and Production Capacity
Our core products are 1C/2C fast-charging prismatic and cylindrical LiPo cells, significantly faster than the industry standard of 0.2C-0.5C. These batteries are widely used in tablets, power banks, solar street lights, smart home appliances, small power tools, and e-scooters. With 20 automated production lines across five facilities in Shipai Town, Dongguan, we maintain a daily output of 2.5 million polymer battery cells and an annual production capacity exceeding 600 million cells as of 2025.

Technical Advantages and Market Position
Recognized as a leader in fast-charging technology for digital lithium cells, Cvasun employs proprietary technology that enables charging from 5% to 95% in just 10 minutes. We prioritize high energy density, safety, consistency, and extended cycle life, supported by multiple patented technologies. Annual R&D investment accounts for over 4% of our main business revenue. This focus on innovation has secured us a dominant market position, holding approximately 60% of China's digital lithium battery market for power banks and an 80% share in the domestic mobile power supply battery segment.

Upstream Integration
To strengthen our industrial chain, we have invested in Guizhou Cvasun New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. This subsidiary operates a 250,000-ton lithium battery cathode material industrial park in Guizhou Province, featuring production lines for LMO and LFP materials.

Corporate Philosophy
Cvasun New Energy adheres to the "Four Optimizations" principle: Process, Equipment, Personnel, and Customer optimization. Our operations are guided by the core values of Innovation, Safety, Reliability, and Durability, ensuring we deliver superior quality and service in all aspects of our business.

Company Overview:

About us
Star King Watch Group is a professional watch and smartwatch manufacturer integrating R&D, production, and sales. Since its establishment in 1993, the company has held prestigious roles such as Executive Vice President of the Shenzhen and Guangdong Watch Industry Associations and Executive Director of the China Watch Association. It has been awarded honors like "Top Ten in China's Light Industry" and "Top Ten in the Watch Industry," showcasing its leading position in the sector. With its national brand "Star Emperor Watch," the group operates a nationwide sales network of over 2,000 brand stores and counter service centers.

Business scope
Our business scope includes domestic/international wholesale, gifts, e-commerce, and one-stop OEM/ODM services. With factory-direct pricing (volume discounts available) and strong support, contact our online customer service for details. Let's achieve win-win cooperation together.

Company philosophy
The company adheres to a people-oriented philosophy and a quality-first principle, supported by a complete scientific quality management system. It has invested in multiple technology parks: Yajiashi and Jingrui in Shenzhen (2008), and a 175-million-yuan industrial base in Zhongshan's Cuiheng New District (2020), housing a watch movement R&D center, smart wearable R&D hub, and e-commerce incubator.

Over 30 years of industry experience
With over 30 years of industry experience, Star King has expanded globally, debuting at the Hong Kong International Watch Fair and Baselworld as early as 1998. Its products are sold in over 30 countries across Europe, the Americas, and the Middle East. The group's factories have more than 15 years of ODM/OEM expertise in smartwatches, with independently developed technologies like the tourbillon movement filling domestic gaps. It now actively shifts to smart wearables, offering full-process OEM/ODM services from R&D to quality control.

Welcome to join us
Star King invites global partners: brand owners, channel distributors, and tech innovators to collaborate under an open, win-win model. We share mature supply chain resources and manufacturing experience to create high-quality smart wearable products and explore global market opportunities.

Since its launch in 2018, the company has centered its R&D on Vertical Rhythm Technology. Through strategically placed Dragonfly Wing Bionic Rhythm Actuators near the waist and legs, the mattress provides a holistic sleep experience promoting relaxation, easing stress, aiding sleep, and enhancing microcirculation. This physical sleep-support method offers a safer, healthier alternative to traditional drug-based solutions for those struggling with insomnia.

Integrated Manufacturing Excellence
Operating from an 18,000sqm modern manufacturing plant located in the Hefei New Station High-tech Zone, serving as its Asia-Pacific production base, the company maintains full control over quality and efficiency. Advanced Rhythm and Sleep Monitoring Systems

Each actuator operates independently across distinct zones, offering six adjustable intensity levels and multiple rhythmic modessuitable for scenarios ranging from full-body relaxation to fatigue recovery and rapid sleep induction. Company Overview:

Introduction
The company was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Bao'an District, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province, a significant hub for electronic manufacturing in China. It is a high-tech enterprise that integrates research and development, production, and sales, focusing on the audio equipment sector. Its main products include live-streaming sound cards, microphones, and remote-controlled microphones, and it serves clients across industries such as online streaming, recording, and gaming entertainment.

Production Capacity
Headquartered in Shenzhen's Fuyong Street Fenghuang First Industrial Zone, our 3,000-square-meter factory houses a complete production line and a dust-free assembly workshop. Annually producing over 300,000 audio cards and related equipment, we demonstrate flexible manufacturing capabilities to quickly respond to customized orders and bulk production demands.

R&D Strength
Furuijie has an independent technical research and development center, with a team of over 20 engineers covering various fields including audio circuit design, embedded system development, and app support development. The company invests more than 10% of its annual revenue in new product development, having applied for and obtained several patents related to audio technology. Typical products such as the V8S and F998 models are independently developed by the internal team and possess independent intellectual property rights.

Quality Certification and Inspection Measures
The company places great importance on product quality management and has obtained ISO 9001 quality management system certification. Its flagship products have passed international certifications such as FCC (Federal Communications Commission of the USA) and CE (European Conformity), complying with overseas market entry standards. The production process implements multiple quality control measures, including IQC (Incoming Quality Control), IPQC (In-Process Quality Control), and OQC (Outgoing Quality Control), ensuring that the product qualification rate is above 99% from raw material procurement to final shipment.

Export Share
Furuijie products are exported to over 30 countries and regions worldwide, particularly gaining a good reputation and stable customer base in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and South America. Exports account for over 80% of the company's total sales, making it an active player among Chinese export-oriented audio equipment manufacturers.

Product Warranty and After-Sales Service
All company products come with a 1-year limited warranty. The after-sales service team supports multilingual responses, covering technical support, remote debugging, repairs, and returns, with a response time not exceeding 24 hours.

Industry Participation and Exhibition Experience
The company actively participates in industry exchanges and brand promotion, having attended the Hong Kong Global Resources Expo multiple times. Through exhibitions, the company continuously expands its international influence and establishes a stable overseas distribution network. The company is also a member of the Shenzhen Audio and Video Industry Association, engaging in the formulation and promotion of audio product standards.

Factory and Personnel Composition
The company currently has over 200 employees, with approximately 75% in production, 15% in R&D, and the rest in marketing, quality control, and management. The factory is equipped with automatic surface mount technology machines, audio testing instruments, aging test rooms, and dust-free assembly workshops, ensuring efficient operations from design to delivery.

Company Overview:

A Legacy of Innovation in Power Solutions
Established in 2001, Huizhou Yinghua Electronic Co., Ltd. is a premier manufacturer and solution provider of advanced power equipment. Operating under the brand Powerhero, our comprehensive product portfolio includes automatic voltage stabilizers (500VA to 200KVA), solar-integrated inverters and UPS systems (500VA to 10KVA), solar power systems (300W to 5,000W), transformers, and converters. We also offer professional power amplifiers through our dedicated sub-brand, Powerdream.

Robust Manufacturing Capabilities and Quality Assurance
Our manufacturing prowess is supported by a 19,000-square-meter facility featuring 8 dedicated production lines and a skilled workforce of over 200 employees, enabling a monthly output of 90,000 units. Quality is embedded in our process, with every product undergoing strict Incoming Quality Control (IQC), 100% online testing, and rigorous load and burn-in testing to ensure unparalleled reliability and performance.

Pioneering Technology and Proprietary R&D
Powerhero has been a technology pioneer since its inception. A key milestone was achieved in 2005 when we mastered the core technology for aluminum transformer production, becoming the industry's first supplier. Our innovations extend to our automatic voltage regulators, which feature our own high-performance, MCU-controlled circuits protected by several registered patents. We have developed specialized solutions, like air-conditioners and three-phase stabilizers, to meet diverse customer needs.

Leadership in Inverter and Solar Technology
In the inverter and UPS field, we were the first to invent toroidal inverters, renowned for their low idle current, minimal electromagnetic interference, extended backup time, and high efficiency. These products are equipped with 32-bit CPU controls and unique C.R.G.O. toroidal transformers. Crucially, all core technologies for our solar-integrated inverters and complete solar power systems are developed in-house by our dedicated R&D team, making us one of the few manufacturers that control its key technology.

Commitment to Excellence and Partnership
Our leadership is sustained by a powerful R&D team, skilled production staff, a comprehensive quality system, and advanced equipment, including state-of-the-art wave soldering and burn-in testing lines. Continuous research and creativity keep our products at the forefront of the industry. We welcome the opportunity to discuss how our innovative and reliable power solutions can drive the success of your next OEM project.

Company Overview:

Company Overview
For over 20 years, Greenwill has been a stationery manufacturer and brand service provider, integrating product development, manufacturing, and sales. Our core competencies lie in producing environmentally friendly erasers and a diverse range of products. With a strong international presence, we offer diversified and professional services to clients worldwide.

Market Leadership & Product Success
Greenwill has emerged as a market leader, earning respect from competitors and customers alike. Our innovative products, including microphone eraser sharpeners, lipstick erasers, painted eggshell series, and pebble series, have gained significant popularity across Asia, Europe, North America, and South America, generating substantial market demand.

Innovation and Patents
All eraser product molds are independently developed and patented by Greenwill. We have set the industrial benchmark through high-precision abrasives, complex extrusion and injection molding processes, and consistent product quality. Our cross-regional collaborations with industrial and graphic designers from Germany, France, South Korea, and Taiwan have strengthened our international development capabilities.

Quality Assurance
Every production detail is strictly monitored by our QC Department through a continuous improvement process. This commitment to quality has earned recognition from domestic and overseas customers, enhancing our brand influence and establishing Greenwill as one of the most trusted manufacturers in the industry.

Social Responsibility & Safety Standards
Greenwill is dedicated to social responsibility, producing safe, non-toxic, and eco-friendly TPR erasers. All raw materials are sourced from world-class suppliers. Our mission is to Benefit People, Love Life, and Promote Harmony. We adhere to European safety standards and rigorous testing protocols, including EN 71-1/2/3/9, REACH, PAHs, CHCC, 6P NP, and ASTM-D-4236.

Employee Care & Workplace Environment
Employees are our most valuable asset. Greenwill provides a healthy, safe, and comfortable working environment where team members can realize their personal and professional values. Our facilities feature excellent ventilation, air conditioning, a basketball court, a gym, and a rose garden, reflecting our people-oriented philosophy and fostering happiness and growth.

Global Clientele & Strategic Partnerships
We serve customers worldwide, including renowned brands such as Papermate, Bic, Maped, Target, Disney, and FILA. Trust-based long-term collaborations, some spanning over 15 years, keep Greenwill at the forefront of the international market.

Product Line Expansion
Building on the success of our internationally acclaimed erasers, along with our core competencies and corporate culture, we have expanded our product range to include pencil sharpeners, pens, and stationery kits--while continuing to prioritize eraser production at the heart of our operations.

Future Vision
As Greenwill continues to diversify its product offerings and strengthen its competitive edge, we are committed to expanding our distribution in both domestic and global markets.

Company Overview:

Since 2002
Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Ningbo, China, Loctek Ergonomics Technology Co., Ltd. is a National Single Champion Demonstration Enterprise that integrates smart-home and overseas public-warehouse operations. Listed on the ChiNext Board of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2017, it is the first listed company in the health ergonomics sector and the first cross-border e-commerce enterprise in China to go public via IPO.

Manufacturing Scale & R&D Strength
With four global manufacturing bases, over 4,000 employees, and business coverage across 115 countries and regions, Loctek operates three high-tech enterprises and maintains a professional R&D team of more than 1,000 members. The team focuses on core fields such as mechatronics, embedded software and hardware, IoT, 5G technology applications, and high-speed low-noise linear drive technologies. Multiple core technologies have broken longstanding foreign monopolies.

R&D Investment & Achievements
In collaboration with industrial chain partners and leading domestic universities, the company has established the industry's first Smart Health Research Institute. With cumulative R&D investment exceeding RMB 480 million over the past three years, Loctek holds a series of national-level qualifications, including the National Enterprise Technology Center, National Industrial Design Center, and National Postdoctoral Research Workstation. It has obtained 1,281 global patents, 190 of which are invention patents, and is recognized as a National Intellectual Property Demonstration Enterprise.

Financial Performance
In 2024, Loctek achieved operating revenue of RMB 5.67 billion, a year-on-year increase of 45.33%. Revenue from overseas warehouse services reached RMB 2.423 billion, up 154.76% year-on-year, while cross-border e-commerce revenue hit RMB 2.026 billion, rising 14.28% year-on-year. In the first three quarters of 2025, the company's total revenue reached RMB 4.846 billion, growing 29.56% year-on-year. Overseas warehouse service revenue stood at RMB 2.348 billion, up 46.2% year-on-year, demonstrating strong and sustained growth momentum.

Founded in 1996, Nantong Foremost Group is a professional one-stop solution provider with a global network, specializing in hats and accessories. Headquartered with key facilities near Shanghai (Nantong, China) and expanded to Cambodia (Goodmate) and Vietnam (Solamoda), the group operates 5 core factories to serve global clients.

 

Diverse Product Range & Strong Production Capacity

Our product portfolio covers a wide spectrum:

Cut & sewn hats (BB caps, bucket hats)
Knitted items (beanies, scarves)
Blocked hats, felts, straws
Soft bags

 

Quality, Compliance & Sustainability

FOREMOST upholds strict quality and ethical standards, holding certifications such as BSCI, GRS, GOTS, SLCP, and Disney's FAMA. Factories undergo rigorous audits by top brands like PVH, Nike, VF Group, and Carhartt. Additional credentials include:

Goodmate (Cambodia): ACT membership & Better Work certification
Solamoda (Vietnam): SMETA & WRAP certifications

 

20 Million Hats Annual Turnout

29 years of manufacturing experience; 80 sample masters for development; Utilizing advanced machines and supported by highly skilled workers, turn out 20 million hats every year. About 35% of the products are shipped to North America & Europe, 32% to Japan, and the rest 33% to China.

 

Design Excellence & Innovation

With 20 experienced designers, periodic inspiration books, and 3D design services, we excel in product development. Our 2,800-square-meter showroom displays 15,000 styles, with 10,000 new designs annually.

 

Some Cooperated Clients & Brands

Established in 2001
Ningbo Jiesheng Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2001. With its predecessor being Ningbo Xiapu Xinsheng Mold Factory, initially, it was a specialized mold factory engaged in the design and manufacture of die-casting molds, plastic molds, and stamping molds. As the business grew, in 2006, Xinsheng Mold Factory established a stamping workshop and a machining workshop, focusing on the production and manufacturing of automotive stamping parts and automotive machining parts.

ISO 16949, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 Certifications
In 2010, we founded Ningbo Kaiminsheng Machinery Co., Ltd, entering the automotive driving shaft component industry. With the continuous expansion of our business, we have gradually developed into a high-end manufacturer in the automotive driving shaft industry and obtained certifications such as the ISO 16949 Quality Management System, ISO 14001 Environmental Management System, and ISO 45001 Occupational Health Management System. At the same time, we were awarded the Level 3 Safety Production Standardization Enterprise Certificate and the High-tech Enterprise Certificate. Our clients include major domestic independent automotive brands and large foreign drivetrain shaft factories, as well as Fortune 500 automotive parts companies. In 2012, Ningbo Xiapu Xinsheng Mold Factory was renamed Ningbo Dingkai Machinery Co., Ltd, specializing in the production of stamping and welding parts for automotive seats and chassis components. Our main customers include Fortune 500 companies such as Marelli, Maana, Tesla, and well-known domestic auto parts factories. In 2017, we established the ergonomics division, specifically providing OEM services for TV brackets and monitor stands for Loctek.

Exporting to the United States, Europe, and Asia
The company has a professional technical and R&D team, consisting of 25 R&D engineers, 20 QA staff, and 130 workers. The factory covers an area of around 27,000m² and supports OEM and ODM projects. Our main products include monitor arms of various specifications, artistic TV floor stands, mobile TV carts, full-motion TV wall mounts, height-adjustable standing desks, laptop desks, and motorized height-adjustable desk frames. These products are primarily sold to markets in the United States, Europe, and Asia.

Notable Projects and Industry Contributions

The company's commitment to quality is reinforced by a comprehensive suite of international certifications, ensuring reliability and regulatory compliance across all operations. About Us
Qingdao Fiklore Packing Co., Ltd. is a leading design-oriented company in the printing and packaging industry, recognized for its unwavering commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability. Since its establishment, the company has served numerous prestigious clients worldwide, providing specialized packaging solutions for the pet food, human food, medical, and health food sectors. We work closely with our clients to develop packaging that is not only visually appealing and functional but also environmentally responsible. In close partnership with Qingdao FourColor Printing Factory, we are dedicated to empowering your business with premium printing and packaging solutions, working together toward a more sustainable and inspiring future.

Our Heritage
FourColor Packaging Limited, established in 2007, continues a rich legacy in product packaging that traces its roots back to Lihua Packaging Limited, founded in 1995. This evolution, driven by a strategic vision for growth, saw Lihua Packaging give rise to FourColor in 2007. Throughout this journey, the company has been under the steady leadership of our Chairman, Mr. Xin, who comes from a family with deep roots in the packaging industry and grew up surrounded by the intricacies of plastic packaging manufacturing. This early exposure fueled his passion and led to a pivotal shift in the company's focus, transitioning from plastic to paper-based solutions that align with eco-friendly and sustainable practices. Today, FourColor Packaging Limited is a distinguished leader in the industry, blending its rich heritage, visionary leadership, and unwavering commitment to environmentally conscious innovation.

Factory Environment
Qingdao FourColor Packaging Co., Ltd. is situated at No. 22 Tianshan Second Road in Qingdao's Jimo District. This strategic location provides excellent access to major transportation routes, ensuring efficient logistics and convenient commuting for our employees. Our 7,800-square-meter factory is set within extensive, thoughtfully designed green spaces, creating a pleasant and eco-friendly industrial environment. This landscaping reflects our commitment to balancing operational functionality with ecological responsibility.

Certifications
As a leading printing and packaging firm, we hold prestigious certifications, including Disney, FSC, ISO 9001:2015, and ISO 14001, which demonstrate our commitment to quality, sustainability, and innovation. Recognized as an Advanced Enterprise in China and holding essential licenses as well as High-Tech Enterprise status, we consistently exceed industry standards. Company History and Brand Strength

Ritek Corporation was founded in 1988 in Taiwan and has built its reputation as the world's expert in storage media. Starting from manufacturing CDs, DVDs, and OLED products, the company laid a strong foundation in precision manufacturing. Over the decades, Ritek has successfully transformed from an optical media manufacturer into a leading provider of flash drives, memory cards, solid state drives, memory modules, and portable storage devices. In addition, Ritek has expanded into renewable energy, photovoltaic modules, building integrated photovoltaics, and LED lighting, creating a diversified and sustainable business portfolio.

Comprehensive Product Lines and Market Applications

Ritek offers a full range of storage products to serve consumer, professional, and enterprise markets. Flash drives and memory cards provide compact and secure data storage for everyday use. DDR4 and DDR5 memory modules deliver high performance for gaming, servers, and professional computing. Solid state drives, including PCIe and SATA interfaces, combine speed and durability for both consumer and industrial systems. Portable SSDs and external drives offer performance with mobility for creators, gamers, and business users. These products serve a wide spectrum of customers, from everyday consumers to large global enterprises.

R&D and Quality Advantages

Ritek is backed by strong and innovative R&D capabilities, transforming emerging technologies into reliable products that set benchmarks in quality, performance, and competitiveness. Our core product is an optical film embedded with micro-louvers, designed to control viewing angles and effectively prevent visual data leakage, thereby safeguarding personal and confidential information.

Customizable Viewing Technology
Leveraging Sewha's proprietary technology (Sewha P&C), our privacy films allow for the precise selection of micro-louver density and exclusion angles to match specific user requirements. This customization ensures optimal privacy and viewing comfort for diverse applications and environments.

Health and Wellness Protection
Our films incorporate a blue light blocking feature to help reduce eye strain, minimize dryness, and mitigate potential sleep disruptions. Durable and Versatile Coatings
To meet varied client needs, we offer multiple coating options such as hard coating for enhanced scratch resistance and diffused reflection coating to minimize glare. With business operations in Hong Kong, Taiwan, Beijing, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Suzhou, the company is well-positioned to serve major electronic manufacturers across the globe.

Product Portfolio
Rooted in a professional team and advanced manufacturing expertise, the company has developed a robust product portfolio. Its offerings range from foundational components to tailored systems, including quartz crystals, crystal oscillators, TCXOs, VCXOs, OCXOs, and crystal filters.

Product Applications
Our components are widely used in a diverse range of applications, including:

Mobile phones and tablets
Satellite and wireless communication systems
In-car electronics and global positioning systems (GPS)
Personal computers and consumer electronics


Key Advantages
Our high-end oscillators support not only CMOS output but also LVDS and LVPECL outputs. They are available in standard package sizes such as 7.0x5.0mm, 5.0x3.2mm, and 3.2x2.5mm, with standard frequencies including 100MHz, 125MHz, 156.25MHz, 200MHz, and 300MHz. Notably, we offer specialized VCXOs, TCXOs, and OCXOs that deliver lower jitter and phase noise for demanding applications. While many of our larger package components (such as 14.0x9.8mm, 7.0x5.0mm, 5.0x3.2mm, and 49SMD) and non-standard frequencies have been designated as End-of-Life (EOL) by other suppliers, we continue to manufacture them to support our clients' long-term needs.

Quality Assurance

EU RoHS Compliance Verified by SGS: As verified by the SGS report No. TAOC2401136501, our products comply with the EU RoHS Directive (EU) 2015/863 on the restriction of hazardous substances (e.g., lead).
REACH & International Standards: Our products adhere to the latest international standards for the management of toxic and hazardous substances, including REACH and others.

Our components are widely used in a diverse range of applications, including:

Mobile phones and tablets
Satellite and wireless communication systems
In-car electronics and global positioning systems (GPS)
Personal computers and consumer electronics


Key Advantages
Our high-end oscillators support not only CMOS output but also LVDS and LVPECL outputs. They are available in standard package sizes such as 7.0x5.0mm, 5.0x3.2mm, and 3.2x2.5mm, with standard frequencies including 100MHz, 125MHz, 156.25MHz, 200MHz, and 300MHz. Notably, we offer specialized VCXOs, TCXOs, and OCXOs that deliver lower jitter and phase noise for demanding applications. While many of our larger package components (such as 14.0x9.8mm, 7.0x5.0mm, 5.0x3.2mm, and 49SMD) and non-standard frequencies have been designated as End-of-Life (EOL) by other suppliers, we continue to manufacture them to support our clients' long-term needs.

Quality Assurance

ISO 9001:2015 Certified: Our quality management system for the production and sales of quartz crystal resonators and oscillators is certified against the GB/T 19001-2016 / ISO 9001:2015 standard.
EU RoHS Compliance Verified by SGS: As verified by the SGS report No. TAOC2401136501, our products comply with the EU RoHS Directive (EU) 2015/863 on the restriction of hazardous substances (e.g., lead).
REACH & International Standards: Our products adhere to the latest international standards for the management of toxic and hazardous substances, including REACH and others.

A Manufacturer with 22 Years of Experience

30,000sqm Luggage Factory
Completed and operational in 2022, the new state-of-the-art CONWOOD factory is easily reached by car from Shanghai and strategically located for accessibility and efficient connection to the company's network of leading material and component suppliers. This all-new facility covers more than 30,000 square meters, including material processing, sheet and shell manufacturing, sewing, testing, logistics and warehousing, and produces what we feel is some of the very best high-performance luggage in the world.

Export to 50+ Countries and Regions
CONWOOD is an international professional luggage operation group integrating brand marketing, design and development, luggage and bag manufacturing, storage and logistics, established in Shanghai Pudong New District in 2002. Since its foundation, products have been exported to Europe, America, Southeast Asia, Dubai, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, and more than 50 countries and regions, establishing a strong international sales network and marketing all over the world. With its unique design, excellent craft and superior quality, CONWOOD has won the honorary title of "High Quality, High Technology" supplier certification in Germany as well.

ODM and OEM Services Provided

ODM: Our design and technology team consists of experienced international designers from Italy, Japan and China. So we are updated about the newest market trends globally and are able to create a unique product design. We have gained more than 120 patents and trademarks.
OEM: With strong R&D capability, advanced international techniques, cutting-edge production equipment and more than a dozen years of OEM manufacturing experience, we have won a good reputation in the luggage industry for our product quality. 


Quality Management System
We already know that travelers have many things to think about on their trip and the last thing they want is to worry about the quality of their luggage. To achieve this international standard of quality and ensure that we spot any defects and issues before we ship out our products, we implement a 6-step quality and safety check that sees our products through handling testing (strength of our retractable handles), multiple drop tests (for durability), running tests (for wheels and moving parts), impact tests (for structural stability), temperature tests (in numerous environments) and of course tumble testing (for protection and bag integrity). Our strict quality management system makes sure each bag that leaves any of our factories, should be of high quality and durability.

Social Responsibility
Conwood has always been committed to the development of public service activities, with the courage to take on the social responsibility of environmental protection, education, disaster relief, and other areas of particular concern.

Over 10 Years of Industry Experience
Since entering the field of luggage export in 2011, SUNWAY has gone through more than ten years of trials and tribulations, accumulating over 10 years of industry experience. These long years have witnessed SUNWAY's gradual growth from an emerging enterprise to an industry leader. Throughout this more than ten-year development process, SUNWAY has always adhered to the persistent pursuit of quality, meticulously crafting each suitcase and each bag like a work of art.

Emphasis on Quality and Design
The luggage and bags it produces not only use high-quality raw materials selected meticulously in terms of materials to ensure sturdiness and durability, able to withstand various tests during travel, such as the bumps of long-distance transportation and the rough handling of luggage at airports, but also keep up with the fashion trend in design, integrating the most popular elements and user-friendly functions. SUNWAY can accurately provide consumers with a rich variety of choices to meet the aesthetic and usage needs of different consumers. This dual emphasis on quality and design has made SUNWAY's products widely praised in the market and become the preferred companion for many consumers' travels and daily lives.

Certifications like SMETA and BSCI
SUNWAY deeply understands that quality is the lifeline of an enterprise, so it spares no effort in quality management. The company's products have all passed strict quality certifications, such as SMETA and BSCI, which are not only a high recognition of SUNWAY's product quality but also a comprehensive affirmation of its production processes, social responsibility fulfillment, and other aspects. Obtaining the SMETA certification means that SUNWAY has reached high standards in ethical trade, including multiple dimensions such as employee rights protection, health and safety, and environmental management, reflecting the company's commitment to sustainable development and social responsibility; while the BSCI certification further proves SUNWAY's excellent performance in business social compliance, ensuring the transparency and fairness of the supply chain. With these certifications, SUNWAY's products have won higher credibility and broader market space in the international market.

Monthly Capacity of 168,000 Pieces of Luggage
SUNWAY also possesses an impressive production capacity. It can produce up to 168,000 pieces of luggage per month, and these luggage all hold SMETA/BSCI certificates. Such a large production scale benefits from SUNWAY's advanced production equipment, efficient production management, and an experienced production team. The advanced production equipment ensures the accuracy and high efficiency of the production process, enabling the rapid transformation of high-quality raw materials into exquisite luggage; the efficient production management optimizes the production process, reduces unnecessary links and waste, and improves production efficiency and stability of product quality; and the experienced production team is one of SUNWAY's core competitiveness. With their superb skills and in-depth understanding of products, they achieve the ultimate in every detail, ensuring that every product leaving the factory can meet SUNWAY's strict quality standards.

Serving Customers in over 50 Countries
Today, Sunway has provided more than 50 customers with high-quality export services. We were recognized by them and have maintained a long-term cooperative relationship.

Company Overview:

About Us

Shenyang Tengxiang Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise specializing in the R&D and design, large-scale production, omni-channel sales, and supporting services of traffic safety products. Since its establishment, we have always adhered to the mission of "Safeguarding Road Safety, Empowering Smart Transportation", deeply engaged in the core track of the traffic safety field, and relied on our full-chain independent operation capabilities to provide one-stop, customized traffic safety solutions for multiple scenarios such as municipal transportation, highway construction, urban management, parks and scenic spots, and logistics and transportation. We have thus become a benchmark enterprise in the industry with both strong technical strength and efficient service.

 

Innovative Design: Demand-Based, Technology-Driven

We have a design team composed of experts in traffic engineering, industrial design, materials science, and other fields. By deeply integrating industry standards, scenario requirements, and cutting-edge technologies, we have built a complete design system covering market research, scheme planning, and product iteration. Whether it is conventional products complying with national/industry standards (such as traffic batons, barrier lights, traffic cones, etc.) or intelligent traffic safety equipment customized for special scenarios (such as intelligent warning lights, solar-powered traffic signs, IoT monitoring terminals), all products are refined through multiple links including 3D modeling, simulation testing, and on-site verification. This ensures that our products possess practicality, durability, and innovation, while meeting the personalized customization needs of different customers.

 

Lean Production: Quality-Oriented, Efficiency-Focused

The company has established a modern production base equipped with industry-leading production equipment and automated production lines, covering full-process production capabilities such as metal processing, injection molding, surface treatment, electronic assembly, and sign printing. We strictly follow the ISO9001 quality management system and have established a full-process quality control mechanism from raw material procurement (selecting high-quality base materials) to production and processing, and finished product inspection. This ensures that every product complies with national traffic safety-related standards and has core advantages such as wind load resistance, corrosion resistance, high and low temperature resistance, and stable reflective performance. The combination of large-scale production and flexible manufacturing not only guarantees the efficient delivery of large-batch orders but also flexibly responds to small-batch customization needs, achieving guarantees of quality and efficiency.

 

Omni-Channel Sales: Channel Linkage, Direct Service

Relying on the "offline + online" omni-channel sales network, we have built a national marketing and service system. Offline, we have a professional sales team and regional service outlets, which can provide customers with full-process services including on-site consultation, scheme customization, installation guidance, and after-sales maintenance. Online, through e-commerce platforms, corporate official websites, and other channels, we realize convenient services such as product display, order docking, and remote consultation, breaking geographical restrictions and improving service response speed. At the same time, we deeply cultivate diversified cooperation models such as government-enterprise cooperation, dealer cooperation, and project customization, and have established long-term and stable cooperative relations with many municipal units, construction enterprises, logistics parks, etc.

AIXBOT reinforces its commitment to innovation by reinvesting 20% of its annual revenue into R&D. This focus has led to breakthroughs like our proprietary SLAM navigation system, which allows for precise robot positioning in complex environments, forming the core of our advanced product offerings.

As an original manufacturer, we oversee every aspect of the production process from design to delivery. This vertical integration allows us to maintain the highest quality standards and ensure our products meet the stringent requirements of our clients. By controlling the entire supply chain, we can implement rigorous quality control measures at every stage, from raw material selection to final assembly. This not only guarantees the reliability and performance of our wireless screen mirroring devices but also enables us to rapidly innovate and adapt to changing market demands.

Low MOQ

About us
Shenzhen Fisang Electronics Co., Ltd. was established in 2010 with a registered capital of CNY10 million. Fisang's factory is located in Bao'an, Shenzhen which focuses on the R&D, manufacturing, and sales of automotive electronic products. It is a comprehensive enterprise. At the beginning of its establishment, the company aimed to build the "FISANG" brand and focused on driving recorder products.

Overview
The company is located 10 kilometers away from Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport and 4 kilometers away from the Shenzhen International Convention and Exhibition Center. The factory and office area are about 5,000 square meters. It has 2 independent R&D laboratories, 2 product testing laboratories, and 5 high-energy production lines. At the same time, the industrial park is equipped with an independent warehousing and logistics center.

R&D
Shenzhen Fisang Electronics Co., Ltd. has always adhered to independent research and development and continued to innovate in the company's business operations. It has successively owned several intellectual property rights related to automobile driving recorder products and has been awarded the National High-tech and Shenzhen High-tech Enterprises. It is also a Shenzhen Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. Vice president unit of the association.

Certifications
As a member of the China Automobile Dealers Association, its products have passed safety certifications such as 3C, CE, and FCC, obtained ISO 9001 quality system certification, and introduced IATF 16949 system management in 2018-2019.

History
In more than 10 years of market operation, the "FISANG" brand driving recorder has always insisted on putting quality first, aiming to enhance user experience, and adhering to safety as the bottom line. At the same time, the product respects the original car and its style and is used in special driving records. The instrument field has products suitable for 99% of the passenger cars in the market and can ensure the speed of product updates within 30 days of the launch of new vehicles from each automaker. It has more than 2,500 types of independent product models. To meet the broader and personalized needs of car owners for car driving recorder products, the "FISANG" brand driving recorder focuses on special car series products while developing and launching a "universal series" and "streaming media rearview mirror series" to the market.

Served more than 20 million domestic users
After more than ten years of perseverance, the "FISANG" brand-driving recorders have served more than 20 million domestic users. The excellent product quality has truly become a "consumer-trusted product" in the hearts of car owners. It has also become the driving recorder of major passenger car manufacturers. Recorder product suppliers and dozens of local governments have been designated to purchase brand products.
