Company Overview:

Core Positioning
Shenzhen Genesbot Technology Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise focused on the research, development, and commercialization of AI-native ecosystem products and autonomous intelligent agent systems. The company specializes in the end-to-end design, system integration, and life cycle technical support of intelligent companion hardware-enabling conventional devices to evolve into context-aware, cognitively adaptive partners capable of personalized, multi-modal interaction and emotionally intelligent engagement. Central to this capability is the company's proprietary AI Agent software platform, which serves as the foundational technological infrastructure for embedding intelligence, behavioral autonomy, and individualized responsiveness into physical hardware.

Core Technological Advantages
Genesbot's technology stack is built upon a vertically integrated, full-stack AI Agent software framework-architect in tandem with an edge-computing-storage infrastructure and a hybrid cloud-edge large language model (LLM) inference system. This unified architecture delivers multi-modal sensing, natural human-machine interaction, and continuous on-device adaptive learning, ensuring ultra-low-latency response, strict end-to-end data sovereignty, and industry-leading operational performance across diverse deployment environments.

Products and Applications
The company has successfully commercialized three flagship product lines: AI-enhanced real-time transcription devices, next-generation smart AI glasses, and emotionally responsive AI companion pets. These solutions are operationally deployed across integrated human-vehicle-hom-office ecosystems, demonstrating robust scenario-specific implementation, cross-domain interoperability, and scalable real-world validation.

Service Offerings
Genesbot provides comprehensive, turnkey intelligent hardware solutions-including industrial-grade mechanical and electrical design, embedded AI firmware development, secure cloud-edge AI orchestration, and co-innovation support across the broader AI hardware ecosystem. This enables strategic partners to accelerate time-to-intelligence, reduce integration complexity, and align product road maps with a shared, future-proof technological foundation.

Vision
By delivering empathetic, intuitive, and contextually grounded interactive experiences, Genesbot aims to advance the paradigm of human-machine symbiosis and establish a globally recognized technical standard for emotionally intelligent, AI-powered companion hardware.

Shenzhen Lingan Wireless Technology Co., Ltd. is a dynamic and fast-growing force in the consumer electronics landscape. Founded in 2018, the company specializes in pioneering wireless control devices, with a core focus on developing innovative smart finger-wearable remote controllers. Our products are meticulously designed to empower short-video creators, mobile professionals, educators, and digital natives, enabling a new standard of hands-free interaction with smart devices.

Expertise in Wearable Innovation
Our core competency lies in specialized wireless wearable control products. The flagship product line of wireless finger ring controllers is engineered specifically for the demands of short-video platforms and mobile productivity, carving out a unique and differentiated position in the wireless peripherals market. This focus is backed by over seven years of deep industry experience in product development and manufacturing, ensuring mature and reliable solutions.

Drivers of Competitive Advantage
Innovation and quality are the twin pillars of our operation. We possess strong in-house research and development capabilities, with over 80% of our team hailing from consumer electronics R&D backgrounds. This expertise is solidified through multiple design and utility patents, guaranteeing exclusivity and long-term value for our partners. Furthermore, every product undergoes strict quality control and adheres to global compliance standards, including CE, RoHS, and FCC certifications, with batteries certified to UN38.3 and MSDS for safe worldwide logistics.

Tailored Partnership Models
We excel at providing flexible OEM and ODM partnership solutions for global brands seeking to build distinctive product lines. Our services encompass comprehensive support, from logo customization and mold adjustments to firmware tuning and packaging design. We understand the needs of market entry and offer flexible Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ) policies, making collaboration ideal for both new product launches and market testing initiatives.

Proven Global Market Reach
Our products have achieved significant international traction, with a strong sales presence across key markets including North America, Europe, Japan, and Korea. We have demonstrated successful penetration through major short-video e-commerce platforms, Amazon FBA, and offline retail channels.

Our Mission
Our mission is to empower users worldwide with lightweight, smart, and intuitive wireless control technology. We are committed to enabling seamless and natural interaction in the mobile era, breaking down the barriers between users and their digital worlds.

Company Overview:

About Us
Shenzhen Maxnon Technology Limited specializes in the production of electronic products, including power banks, battery cases, and wireless chargers. Our products are designed to meet the needs of our customers who demand the highest level of performance, quality, and reliability. We use the latest technology and adhere to the strictest quality standards to ensure our products are of the highest quality.

Benefit from Our Advantages
Our achievements are as follows:

2010: Battery cases for iPhone 4 were developed, and the sales volume reached more than one million USD.
2011: Battery cases for iPhone 4s and Samsung Galaxy S II (i9100) were developed, and the sales volume reached more than 1.5 million USD.
2012: Battery cases for iPhone 5 and Samsung Galaxy S III (i9300) were developed, and the sales volume exceeded two million USD.
2013: Battery cases for iPhone 5/5c/5s (3-in-1), Samsung Galaxy S IV (i9500), HTC One M7, and Samsung Galaxy Note 3 were developed, and the sales volume reached over three million USD, and we became a supplier of battery cases for iPhone to Tesco in the UK after being RoHS-certified by their lab.
2014: Battery cases for Samsung Galaxy S5 were launched in March; battery case for iPhone 6/6s was launched in September; battery case for iPhone 6/6s plus was launched in October. And we attended two trade shows, like Electronics & Components.
2015: New battery case for iPhone 6/6s, MFi lighting cables, and multiple USB chargers were developed. We attended Cebilt and Electronics & Components.
2016: Battery case and the AUX lightning cable for iPhone 7 will come out soon.
Since 2017, we have been focusing on developing private models for all iPhone models, and in the three years (2018, 2019, and 2020), the shipment volume of iPhone battery cases has been far ahead in the industry.
In 2020, we expanded our research and development team to focus on the development of magnetic wireless charging products. After three years of practice and effort, our products have gained a lot of customer recognition and appreciation at the exhibition, and we have collaborated with many international, well-known brands.


Accept ODM and OEM Projects 
We have professional production lines, 100% brand new and high-quality products, and good after-sales services. We have helped our customers to build a famous brand charger series. Our customers speak highly of our strict quality control. Our products have passed MFi, UL, FCC, CE, and RoHS approvals. To be able to face the ever-changing demands of the market, we have accumulated rich experience in dealing with ODM and OEM projects for USB power adapters, mobile power solutions, data transfers, charging cables, travel charging devices, protective cases, and portable music accessories.

Company Overview:

Dedicated to innovative dash cam solutions since 2016

Our products are suitable for a broad spectrum of vehicles, including passenger cars, motorcycles, bicycles, electric bicycles, and various types of new-energy and electric vehicles. Over the years, we have focused on intelligent imaging technology, safety recording systems, and user-centered product design, gradually becoming a reliable partner for global customers seeking professional vehicle camera solutions.

Our two brands: AKEEYO and CHIGEE
Our company operates two major brands: AKEEYO and CHIGEE. Each brand is positioned to meet diverse market demands while sharing the same commitment to quality and innovation. We take pride in our strong research and development capabilities. Our R&D team consists of more than 20 experienced engineers and technical experts specializing in optics, image processing, embedded systems, industrial design, and software development. This multidisciplinary team continuously explores cutting-edge technologies such as high-definition night vision, wide-dynamic-range imaging, AI-based driving assistance, and cloud connectivity to deliver products that exceed customer expectations.

Our pursuit

Partner with us
Looking ahead, Shenzhen Musheng Technology Co., Ltd. will continue adhering to the values of innovation, integrity, and customer orientation. Company Overview:

Company Overview and Core Business
Shenzhen Taiji Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer and supplier engaged in the R&D, production, and sales of watch straps and smart wearable accessories. With years of rich industry experience, we focus on providing high-quality, durable, and fashionable products, including watch straps made of various materials and matching smart accessories, to serve global buyers with reliable supply capabilities and professional customization services.

Professional R&D Capability
We boast a professional R&D team of more than 12 members, with an average industry experience of over eight years. Every year, we launch no less than 50 new products, keeping pace with the latest interface and size standards of smart watches and wearable devices. We have also established 15 core process standards to ensure product precision and stability.

Diverse High-Quality Materials
Our product range includes watch straps made of various high-quality materials: top-grain cow leather or sheep leather, food-grade silicone, 300D or 600D nylon thread, 304 or 316 stainless steel, as well as multi-material composite straps. Each material is strictly selected and tested to meet international quality standards, ensuring durability and comfort.

Strong Production & Delivery Capacity
Our monthly production capacity reaches more than 80,000 genuine leather straps, more than 150,000 silicone straps, and more than 120,000 nylon straps. We promise a delivery time of 3-7 days for standard models, 10-15 days for customized models, and can start sampling within 48 hours for emergency orders.

Reliable Quality & Certification 
We have passed the ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification, and all our products comply with RoHS and REACH environmental requirements, with hazardous substance content meeting EU standards. For each batch of products, we provide material test reports and finished product inspection reports, ensuring full traceability to production batches.

Customization & Efficient Service
We offer professional customization services, including logo laser engraving, screen printing and stamping, with an accuracy of plus or minus 0.05 millimeters. We support multi-size, multi-color and multi-accessory combination customization, with a minimum order quantity of five hundred pieces per model. We respond to customer inquiries within two hours and complete sampling and send samples within 3-5 days.

Company Overview:

About Us
As a self-owned brand under Shenzhen Kunxing Technology Co., Ltd., LokYung Times is a leading manufacturer in the mobile phone charger industry with 22 years of deep expertise in R&D and manufacturing. LokYung has established an excellent reputation as one of the largest global manufacturers of chargers and adapters. Since the group was founded in 2003, the factory has been committed to providing high-quality and high-performance charging products worldwide. It offers Type-C chargers, USB chargers, gallium nitride (GaN) chargers, and fast-charging series supporting PD/QC/VOOC protocols, which are widely applicable to mobile phones, laptops, massagers, POS machines, small household appliances, as well as new energy and industrial power supply sectors. OEM/ODM customization and brand agency cooperation models are supported. LokYung Times boasts a team of 100 professional R&D personnel and senior technical engineers who hold 24 invention patents, 115 utility model patents, and 220 design patents.

Advanced Production Equipment and Strong Production Capacity
LokYung factory is equipped with internationally leading facilities, including high-precision SMT chip mounting lines, automated plug-in equipment, intelligent assembly lines, and professional testing devices. These ensure high production efficiency, precision, and consistency.

Injection molding machines: 25 units
Intelligent aging equipment: 120 units
Ultrasonic machines: 60 units
Full-automatic SMT lines: 8 lines
Automatic DIP production lines: 9 lines
Fully automatic assembly lines: 12 lines
Online CCD testing machines: 9 units
Factory floor space: 30000 square meters
Number of factory employees: 1300
Monthly capacity: 6.5 million units


Strict Quality Management System
From raw material procurement to product delivery, every process adheres to international quality management standards. Certified to ISO 9001, LokYung has established comprehensive quality control procedures and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Raw materials undergo strict sampling inspections, multiple quality control points monitor production in real time, and all products undergo 100% final inspections (including electrical performance, safety testing, and appearance checks) to ensure compliance with high-quality standards.

Professional R&D Team
LokYung's R&D team consists of 80 senior engineers with deep expertise in power supply technology, electronic circuit design, and materials science. The team stays abreast of industry trends and technological advancements and continuously invests in developing innovative and competitive charging products.

International Certifications
We hold multiple international certifications to validate product quality and safety, including CE, FCC, UL, and ROHS. These certifications not only endorse our quality but also serve as passports to global markets, ensuring compliant sales worldwide.

Extensive Market Reach
Our products are sold in multiple countries and regions across Europe, America, Asia, and Africa. In international markets, our superior quality and reputation have enabled long-term partnerships with many globally renowned brands.

Partnerships
Our partner brands include OPPO, Lenovo, OnePlus, Nubia, LAVA, Coolpad, Huawei, 360, momax, Micromax, Haier, OSKAR, Greenhouse, Baseus, AUKEY, and more.

Company Overview:

Since 2007
Founded in 2007, Sinocastel is a national high-tech GPS tracker manufacturer integrating R&D, production, sales & operations, focusing on the research and production of vehicle GPS telematics and solutions. As a nationally certified high-tech R&D base for automotive electronics and a national high-tech enterprise, Sinocastel is China's first GPS tracker company to develop onboard terminal equipment with communication and bus technology. Sinocastel hardware and solutions have been widely used in fleet management, auto insurance UBI, telecommunications industry, car rental business, and home care services.

Products Applied in 146 Countries Around the World
In 2008, Sinocastel successfully developed an OBD device with a communication function that truly combined automotive internal data communication (ECU) and external wireless communication technology, and successfully applied it to more than 1,000 channel customers in 146 countries around the world. Sinocastel has been actively exploring the application of OBD GPS tracking technology in the field of insurance UBI since 2010 and has cooperated with insurance companies such as Ping An Insurance, An Bang Insurance, and PICC. Sinocastel entered the IoT market in 2008, focusing on the design, research, and development of IoT big data terminals. It has big data processing and management capabilities for car companies and has conducted extensive and in-depth research with new energy electronic vehicle manufacturers' cooperation.

Certified with ISO 9001:2008, CCC, EMARK, ANATEL, etc.
Sinocastel has a diverse product line. The main hardware products include OBD trackers, GPS/Beidou trackers for various vehicles, wired GPS trackers, asset GPS trackers, T-BOX, etc, Our products cover multiple technologies based on Bluetooth, GSM, CDMA, WCDMA, LTE, etc., and have passed ISO 9001:2008, CCC, EMARK, ANATEL, AT&T, CE, FCC, PTCRB, JATE, TELEC, and other certifications. 

Backed by 2 R&D Centers
Sinocastel has two R&D centers in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, more than 70% of engineers have a master's degree, and the core personnel are all senior engineers in the industry. The R&D team continues to break through the core technology, forming a comprehensive and reasonable layout of product planning, technology R&D, testing and application, and technical support. The management team has more than 10 years of experience in automotive electronics research and development, internet of vehicle solution design, and operation services, and has accumulated rich experience in automotive bus technology, wireless communication technology, and GPS position technology.

Company Overview

Skysea Electronic Products Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer specialized in clocks and watches, such as table clocks, wall clocks, flip clocks, gear clocks, LCD clocks, digital clocks, promotional watches, and some promotional gift items. We have a 6,800sqm factory with 300 skilled workers and 20 professional engineers.

Founded with a mission to blend traditional watchmaking heritage, we specialize in the full-cycle production of high-quality timepieces, from concept design and component manufacturing to assembly, testing, and global distribution.

 

Core Capabilities & Production Strength

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facility spans over 6,800 square meters, equipped with advanced CNC machining centers, automated assembly lines, and precision testing equipment that adhere to international quality standards (CE and RoHS certifications). We boast a professional team of engineers, watchmakers, and technicians with an average of 10+ years of experience, mastering every critical process. Our monthly production capacity reaches 80,000 units, supporting both large-scale bulk orders and customized small-batch production to meet diverse market demands.

 

Technological Innovation & R&D Excellence

Innovation is the driving force behind our success. We maintain a dedicated R&D center focused on different designs.  We also hold multiple patents for design innovation, ensuring our products stand out in performance and reliability.

 

Diverse Product Portfolio

We offer a comprehensive range of timepieces catering to various market segments:

Consumer Clocks: Fashionable quartz clocks, mechanical clocks, and animal clock design for children, with customizable designs for brands and retailers.
Specialized Clocks: Precision wall clocks, table clocks, and outdoor clocks for commercial spaces, public facilities, and home decoration, including custom logo and theme designs.
Custom Collections: High standard wall calendar clock, and personalized timepieces tailored for high-end clients and corporate gifting.

 

Quality Assurance & Sustainability

Quality is embedded in every step of our production process. We implement rigorous quality control measures, including 24-hour accuracy testing, strict IQC procedure, and durability trials, ensuring each timepiece meets the highest standards of performance and reliability. Committed to sustainability, we adopt eco-friendly production practices - reducing energy consumption, minimizing waste, and using recyclable packaging - to contribute to a greener future. Our products undergo strict compliance checks to meet international regulations, enabling seamless distribution across global markets.

 

Global Partnership & Service

We have established long-term partnerships with retailers and distributors worldwide, providing OEM/ODM services tailored to their specific needs. Our professional sales and after-sales teams offer comprehensive support - from product development consulting and sample customization to logistics coordination and technical assistance - ensuring a smooth and efficient collaboration. 

As a trusted manufacturer in the clock industry, we remain committed to upholding the spirit of craftsmanship, driving technological innovation, and delivering exceptional timepieces that stand the test of time. We welcome global partners to collaborate with us and explore the endless possibilities of precision timekeeping.

Company Overview:

Specializing in AR Smart Hardware Development
INAIR (operated by Weihai Duoping Future Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.) is a cutting-edge technology company founded in 2022, specializing in AR smart hardware development. We deliver next-generation all-in-one mobile computing terminals and solutions to consumers. With a team rich in XR industry experience, INAIR has successfully launched three generations of AR smart hardware products, secured orders from major Chinese enterprises, and set a record as the top-selling product in the XR category on the e-commerce platform.

Product Vision & Experience
INAIR is an AR spatial computing device built for productivity, seamlessly blending a virtual workspace into a lightweight headset and main unit for an immersive, portable experience. With refined ergonomics and intuitive spatial interactions, INAIR redefines UI constraints, enabling applications to be systematically arranged and dynamically managed. Its cutting-edge multimodal AI recognition powers proactive, intelligent interactions, delivering a groundbreaking integrated experience.

Intuitive Interaction Methods
INAIR enables intuitive and efficient interaction through spatial raycasting, touch, motion sensing, and voice control. Users can navigate interfaces via gaze selection, gesture tapping, or touch sliding. Keyframes include interface activation, window switching, and interaction confirmation. A linear motor provides haptic feedback for enhanced precision. The AI assistant predicts user needs based on behavior, enabling seamless multitasking with minimal intervention, making interactions smarter and more efficient.

Market Context & Need
As digitalization accelerates, traditional work is limited by hardware, fragmented interactions, and inefficiency. Remote work is growing but unevenly applicable-over 50% of finance and IT jobs can go remote, while roles needing collaboration or specialized tools struggle. People seek freedom from spatial and device constraints, aiming for seamless productivity and better work-life balance.

Overcoming Design and Engineering Challenges
The biggest challenge of this project was integrating complex functionalities and numerous components into a sleek, compact, and lightweight design. To enable an efficient multi-screen workspace, the device needed to support high-performance computing, high-definition displays, and intelligent interaction, features that typically require bulky hardware. The team conducted in-depth research on hardware stacking, thermal management, and power optimization. Through material innovations and structural design, they ensured that the device remained lightweight while delivering exceptional performance and user experience.

OEM and ODM Services
Our extensive resources, including over 80 R&D staff, more than 30 engineers, and 7 production lines, allow us to maintain a monthly production capacity of well over 1 million pieces, and thereby satisfy customers' OEM and ODM requirements in countries and regions such as the US, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and Australia.

Product Leadership
Leaders: our leaders have over 25 years of experience in the video interface industry and an extensive appetite for new product ideas. Leading teams of good design, hardware & software engineering, and full-chain supply, the company is able to come up with PoC ideas and turn them into real products with competitiveness.
Fulfilling Diversified Needs: as the market becomes more diversified and starts to meet the needs of the long tail, we're undertaking more ODM projects for famous brand names, delivering products to governments and participating in corporate efficiency-improvement plans.
